Bone-in short ribs are seasoned and quickly seared to develop a rich, dark crust, locking in savory juices before entering the pot. Whole golden shallots, sliced fresh carrots, and smashed garlic cloves form a fragrant aromatics base that caramelizes lightly in the rendered pan drippings. A full-bodied red wine reduction dissolves all the caramelized bits from the bottom of the pot, creating an intensely savory liquid base enriched with rich beef broth and sprigs of earthy garden thyme. As the stew cooks under pressure, the connective tissues melt into tender perfection while the red wine sauce reduces to a silky finish. A final touch of cold butter stirred in right before serving gives the glossy sauce a velvety texture that coats every bite of tender beef. "summary": "Designed for effortless entertaining and busy weeknight prep, this Korean roasted pork belly relies on a deep overnight marinade to deliver maximum flavor with minimal same-day effort. Strips of savory pork belly soak up a balanced mixture of savory soy sauce, spicy gochujang chili paste, sweet brown sugar, and tangy pear juice that tenderizes the meat while infusing intense savoriness. Sliced ginger and crushed garlic add vibrant sharp notes that cut cleanly through the rich profile of the pork belly. When ready to cook, high-heat roasting in the oven renders the marbled fat into crispy edges while keeping the interior juicy and tender. As the natural sugars caramelize on the hot pan, they create a sticky glaze that clings beautifully to every piece. Preparing this dish ahead allows the flavors to mature fully inside the refrigerator before baking. Serve these glazed pork belly strips sliced alongside steamed rice, pickled radish, and fresh lettuce wraps for an customizable meal that tastes like it took hours of active preparation.",
